title: Rubric - Objectivity
evidence: All 22 non-visual criteria (1-15, 24-30) use objective, testable language: existence checks ('Output includes a valid .zip file named'), format matching ('in the prescribed telemetry format, matching the corresponding expected file'), numerical tolerances ('within plus or minus 10 percent'), monotonicity checks ('never decreases'), exact text matching ('reproduces the exact wording and line breaks'), and behavioral comparisons anchored to expected files ('consistent with the corresponding expected file'). No non-visual criterion uses subjective terms such as 'good', 'nice', or 'appropriate'. Count: 0 subjective out of 22 non-visual = 0%.
minor_issues: Criterion hygiene: criterion 17 (visual) is missing terminal punctuation — ends with '...matching the token appearance in the corresponding expected file' with no period. Does not affect this component's score since it is a visual criterion.
